tool_schemas.name: read_query
tool_schemas.description: Executes a read-only SELECT statement against the specified workspace database and returns the result rows (up to max_rows, capped by the database’s max_result_rows) along with execution metadata. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if sql is empty, not a SELECT/read-only statement, max_rows is < 1, or params do not match the number of '?' placeholders; raises NOT_FOUND if the workspace_id or database_id does not exist or is not accessible in that workspace. Raises FORBIDDEN if you are not authorized for the workspace/database, QUOTA_EXCEEDED if query/execution limits are exceeded, and SQL_ERROR for SQL syntax/runtime errors.

workspace_id.description: Workspace identifier that owns the target database.

database_id.description: Database identifier to run the query against.

params.description: Positional parameter values for '?' placeholders in the SQL.

max_rows.description: Maximum number of rows to return (capped by database max_result_rows).

tool_schemas.name: write_query
tool_schemas.description: Executes a write statement (INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE) against the specified workspace database and returns execution metadata including affected row counts when available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if sql is empty or not a supported write statement, or if params do not match the number of '?' placeholders; raises NOT_FOUND if the workspace_id or database_id does not exist or is not accessible in that workspace. Raises FORBIDDEN if you are not authorized, QUOTA_EXCEEDED if write/execution limits are exceeded, and SQL_ERROR for constraint violations, syntax errors, or other SQLite runtime errors.

workspace_id.description: Workspace identifier that owns the target database.

database_id.description: Database identifier to run the query against.

sql.description: Write SQL to execute (INSERT, UPDATE, or DELETE).

params.description: Positional parameter values for '?' placeholders in the SQL.

tool_schemas.name: create_table
tool_schemas.description: Executes a CREATE TABLE or CREATE VIEW statement in the specified workspace database and returns execution metadata for the schema change. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if sql is empty or not a CREATE TABLE/VIEW statement; raises NOT_FOUND if the workspace_id or database_id does not exist or is not accessible in that workspace. Raises FORBIDDEN if you are not authorized, QUOTA_EXCEEDED if schema-change/execution limits are exceeded, and CONFLICT/SQL_ERROR when the object already exists, the DDL is invalid, or the database rejects the change.

workspace_id.description: Workspace identifier that owns the target database.

database_id.description: Database identifier where the table should be created.

sql.description: CREATE TABLE/VIEW SQL statement to execute.

tool_schemas.name: list_tables
tool_schemas.description: Lists tracked tables/views in the specified database, optionally filtered by type and status, sorted by the requested field and order; returns up to limit results and a next cursor when more results are available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid limit/cursor/sort/order/type/status values; raises NOT_FOUND if the workspace_id or database_id does not exist or is not accessible in that workspace. Raises FORBIDDEN if you are not authorized and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if listing/rate limits are exceeded.

workspace_id.description: Workspace identifier that owns the target database.

database_id.description: Database identifier whose tables should be listed.

status.description: Optional filter by table tracking status.

limit.description: Maximum number of tables to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

sort.description: Field to sort the results by.

tool_schemas.name: describe_table
tool_schemas.description: Returns schema information for the named table or view in the specified database (for example columns and related metadata). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if table_name is empty; raises NOT_FOUND if the workspace_id or database_id does not exist or is not accessible, or if the table/view name does not exist in that database. Raises FORBIDDEN if you are not authorized and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if schema-inspection/rate limits are exceeded.

workspace_id.description: Workspace identifier that owns the target database.

database_id.description: Database identifier that contains the table.

table_name.description: Name of the table or view to describe.

tool_schemas.name: append_insight
tool_schemas.description: Appends a new insight entry to the workspace’s memo for the specified database and returns the created insight record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if insight_text is empty or source_execution_id is malformed; raises NOT_FOUND if the workspace_id or database_id does not exist or is not accessible, or if source_execution_id is provided but does not exist. Raises FORBIDDEN if you are not authorized and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if insight/audit limits are exceeded.

workspace_id.description: Workspace identifier that owns the insight memo.

database_id.description: Database identifier the insight relates to.

insight_text.description: Business insight text to append to the memo.

source_execution_id.description: Optional SQL execution id that produced/justified this insight.

tool_schemas.name: get_current_identity
tool_schemas.description: Returns the authenticated caller identity inferred from the presented API key, including the resolved workspace, granted scopes, and current quota / rate-limit consumption. Raises UNAUTHENTICATED if no API key is provided or the key cannot be verified; raises FORBIDDEN if the api key is revoked or the workspace is deleted.

api_key.description: API key credential used to authenticate this request; passed exactly as provided by the client.

tool_schemas.name: create_database
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new SQLite database within the specified workspace and returns the created database record. Raises UNAUTHENTICATED if the API key is missing/invalid; raises FORBIDDEN if the API key is revoked, the workspace is not active, or scopes do not permit creation; raises CONFLICT if a database with the same name already exists in the workspace.

api_key.description: API key credential used to authenticate this request.

workspace_id.description: Workspace identifier that will own the new database.

name.description: Human-friendly unique database name (unique per workspace).

file_path.description: Server-side database file path to use; if omitted, the server allocates a managed path.

pragma_settings.description: Optional PRAGMA settings applied when opening the database (for example journal_mode, synchronous).

max_result_rows.description: Maximum rows that may be returned by read_query; if omitted, workspace or server default applies.

tool_schemas.name: list_databases
tool_schemas.description: Lists databases in the specified workspace, optionally filtered by lifecycle status and name prefix, returning up to limit results and a next cursor when more results are available. Raises UNAUTHENTICATED if the API key is missing/invalid; raises FORBIDDEN if the API key is revoked or scopes do not permit listing; raises NOT_FOUND if the workspace_id does not exist or is not accessible.

api_key.description: API key credential used to authenticate this request.

workspace_id.description: Workspace identifier whose databases should be listed.

status.description: Optional filter by database lifecycle status.

name_prefix.description: Optional prefix filter on database name.

limit.description: Maximum number of databases to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

sort.description: Field to sort the results by.

tool_schemas.name: update_database
tool_schemas.description: Updates mutable fields of an existing database (for example name, pragma_settings, max_result_rows) and/or performs lifecycle status transitions (online/read_only/offline/deleted). Returns the updated database record. Raises UNAUTHENTICATED if the API key is missing/invalid; raises FORBIDDEN if the API key is revoked, scopes do not permit updates, or the requested status transition is not allowed; raises NOT_FOUND if the workspace_id or database_id does not exist or is not accessible; raises CONFLICT if renaming would violate uniqueness.

api_key.description: API key credential used to authenticate this request.

workspace_id.description: Workspace identifier that owns the database.

pragma_settings.description: Replacement PRAGMA settings to persist for this database. (Server applies on open; does not retroactively rewrite data.)

max_result_rows.description: New cap for rows returned by read_query.

status.description: Optional lifecycle transition target. Allowed transitions: online<->read_only, online/read_only->offline, offline->online, and any non-deleted->deleted.

tool_schemas.name: list_sql_executions
tool_schemas.description: Lists SQL execution/audit log entries for the specified workspace (optionally restricted to a database), with pagination and filtering by status and time range. Returns execution records including metadata such as tool_name, duration, row counts, and error_message when failed. Raises UNAUTHENTICATED if the API key is missing/invalid; raises FORBIDDEN if the API key is revoked or scopes do not permit audit access; raises NOT_FOUND if the workspace_id (or database_id, when provided) does not exist or is not accessible.

api_key.description: API key credential used to authenticate this request.

workspace_id.description: Workspace identifier whose execution logs should be listed.

database_id.description: Optional database identifier to filter executions.

status.description: Optional filter by execution lifecycle status.

tool_name.description: Optional filter by originating tool name.

created_after.description: Optional inclusive lower bound on created_at.

created_before.description: Optional exclusive upper bound on created_at.

limit.description: Maximum number of execution records to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

tool_schemas.name: cancel_sql_execution
tool_schemas.description: Requests cancellation of an in-flight SQL execution (queued or running) and returns the updated execution record. If the execution has already reached a terminal state, the server refuses with CONFLICT. Raises UNAUTHENTICATED if the API key is missing/invalid; raises FORBIDDEN if the API key is revoked or scopes do not permit cancellation; raises NOT_FOUND if the workspace_id or execution_id does not exist or is not accessible.

api_key.description: API key credential used to authenticate this request.

workspace_id.description: Workspace identifier that owns the execution.

metadata.name: SQLite Database Server
metadata.description: This backend models a multi-tenant SQLite database server that exposes tools to create tables, run read/write SQL, inspect schema, and maintain a simple memo of business insights. The main workflows are: authenticate a client, execute SQL statements against a specific database, record execution/audi
